dialogue.content: （今日はよろしくお願いします。お時間になりましたら始めます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for being here today. We'll begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.content: （今晩は、よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. Thank you for seeing me.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: はじめに、ご年齢と性別、ご相談したいことを伺えますか？
dialogue.English: To begin, may I ask your age and gender, and what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 40代、女性、人間関係が辛いです
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 40s, and I'm struggling with relationships.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、人間関係にお辛い気持ちを抱えているんですね。具体的にどんな感じなのかもう少し伺えますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you’re having a hard time with relationships. Could you tell me a bit more about what that's like for you?

dialogue.content: 会社で苦手というか、ストレスになる人が何人かいます
dialogue.English: At work, there are a few people I find difficult, or rather, who are a source of stress for me.

dialogue.content: 高圧的で、仕事はできるのですが、難しい人です
dialogue.English: They're overbearing, competent at their jobs, but difficult people.

dialogue.content: 仕事は見て覚えてみたいな人で、聞くのも怖い感じです
dialogue.English: They're the type of person who expects you to learn by watching, and it's intimidating to even ask questions.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…それはなかなか難しいですね。あなたはそういう方とうまくやり合ってこられたんですか？
dialogue.English: I see... That sounds quite difficult. Have you been managing to get along with people like that?

dialogue.content: うまくやれているかはわかりませんが、結構我慢してて限界かなと思ってます
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if I'm managing well; I've been putting up with a lot, and I feel like I'm reaching my limit.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。仕事上関わり合うのは避けて通れないと思いますので、あなたなりに随分こらえて来たんでしょうね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Since it's unavoidable to interact with them at work, it sounds like you've been enduring quite a bit in your own way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自分が少し我慢して周囲への配慮や気くばりをされてきたんでしょうかね。そろそろ限界でお辛い感じなんですね？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've been holding yourself back a bit to be considerate and thoughtful towards others. And now you're feeling pained because you're reaching your limit?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。頑張ってこられましたね。高圧的な方と接するのは気持ちも萎縮してしまいますね。最近、会社ではそういった方とはどのように接しておられるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. You've really been trying hard. Dealing with an overbearing person can be quite intimidating. How have you been interacting with them at work recently?

dialogue.content: 上司なので、気を遣っています。
dialogue.English: Since they're my supervisor, I tread carefully.

dialogue.content: 上司の方でしたか、尚更気をつかいますね。上司の方はあなたとは長いお付き合いなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So it's your supervisor—that makes you all the more cautious. Have you known this supervisor for a long time?

dialogue.content: そうでもないです。私は転職したので、一年経たないくらいです
dialogue.English: Not really. I changed jobs, so it's been less than a year.

dialogue.content: ご転職されてこられたんですね。あなたにとって今回の上司の方のようなタイプはこれまであったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you changed jobs. Have you ever encountered a supervisor of this type before?

dialogue.content: タイプですか？全く同じ感じはないですよね。
dialogue.English: A type? No one has been exactly the same, no.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。では、きっと今ご苦労されていますね。ご転職されて、社会経験もあるあなたから見て、周りの方はどんなふうにその方と接しているように思えますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Then you must be struggling now. From your perspective, with your work experience, how do your colleagues seem to interact with this person?

dialogue.content: そうですね。同じ部屋の人は対立してる人もいますし、同じ部屋ではない人はよく分かってないし、上司にあたるので、気を遣ってます
dialogue.English: Let's see. Some people in the same room are in conflict with them, people who aren't in the same room don't really understand, and since they are the supervisor, people are careful around them.

dialogue.content: 上司には気を遣ってしまいますよね。同じ部屋で対立している方もいらっしゃるんですね。そういう方とは何かあなたのお気持ちを話せる関係はありますか？
dialogue.English: It's natural to be careful with a supervisor. And you mentioned there are people in the same room who are in conflict with them. Do you have the kind of relationship with any of them where you could talk about how you feel?

dialogue.content: 話せないですね。上司の愚痴を言える環境ではないです。逆に間に入って愚痴を聞いてる方なので、疲れますね
dialogue.English: Not really. It's not an environment where I can vent about my supervisor. If anything, I'm the one stuck in the middle listening to others' complaints, which is exhausting.

dialogue.content: それはあなたも色々疲れますね。…少し伺いますが、あなたのお辛い気持ちは、あなたにとって上司への愚痴だとお考えですか？または他にも会社でお辛い場面はありますか？
dialogue.English: That would be draining for you, too. May I ask: do you see your distress as simply a matter of complaining about your supervisor, or are there other painful situations at work as well?

dialogue.content: 上司からの圧が強いこと、思い通りに動いて欲しいという期待にも疲れます。正解がその都度違うので、、
dialogue.English: The pressure from my supervisor is intense, and I'm exhausted by the expectation that I do exactly as they want. The 'right answer' keeps changing each time...

dialogue.content: 隣で人の悪口をずっと聞いているのも嫌ですね
dialogue.English: I also hate constantly hearing them badmouth others right next to me.

dialogue.content: いろいろありますね。期待されていると感じても現実に聞こえてくる愚痴に嫌気もさすでしょうね。職場がどんなふうになったら、あなたが気持ちよく働けるか考えていきたいです
dialogue.English: There are many layers to this. Even if you feel expectations are placed on you, hearing the complaints in reality must be disheartening. I'd like us to think about what would need to change at work for you to feel comfortable working there.

dialogue.content: 転職した方がいいのか悩んでます
dialogue.English: I'm torn about whether I should change jobs.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、転職も迷っていらっしゃるんですね。悩んでいるということは続けたいお気持ちもあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you're also considering changing jobs. Does the fact that you're torn mean there's a part of you that wants to stay?

dialogue.content: 年齢的に仕事が見つからないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think I'll be able to find a job at my age.

dialogue.content: 体が拒否するくらい、仕事に行きたくないんです
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to work to the point that my body feels like it's rejecting it.

dialogue.content: 眠れないし、辛いんです
dialogue.English: I can't sleep, and it's really painful.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…それはかなりしんどかったですね
dialogue.English: I see... That must have been incredibly tough.

dialogue.content: こういう状況はあなたにとって初めてですか？
dialogue.English: Is this the first time you've experienced a situation like this?

dialogue.content: 初めてとは、どういう意味ですか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by 'the first time'?

dialogue.content: 例えば、これまで何か辛い場面に遭遇して、今回のように眠れない、体が拒否するように感じることはありましたか？
dialogue.English: For example, have you ever encountered a difficult situation before and felt unable to sleep or like your body was rejecting it, as you do now?

dialogue.content: 眠れないとかはありますね
dialogue.English: I've had trouble sleeping before, yes.

dialogue.content: 眠れないと次の日に影響もあるでしょうし、苦しいですね。どういう風に乗り越えてこられたんでしょうか
dialogue.English: Not being able to sleep must affect the next day, and it's distressing. How have you overcome it in the past?

dialogue.content: 乗り越えられてないので、相談に来てます
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to overcome it, which is why I came for counseling.

dialogue.content: 乗り越えるようにお役に立ちたいと思います。あなたにとって、どんな風になったらベストでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to help you overcome this. For you, what would the best outcome look like?

dialogue.content: 自分の仕事が進めればいいですね。隣でずっと上司の話を聞かなきゃいけないので、それがなくなってほしいです
dialogue.English: It would be nice if I could just get on with my own work. I have to listen to my supervisor talk all the time next to me, and I want that to stop.

dialogue.content: その人と関わりたくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want to have anything to do with that person.

dialogue.content: 関わりたくない、と思って当然ですよね。あなたは眠れないくらいにお辛いんですから…よく耐えていらっしゃると思いますが、お身体のことを考えると心配です。身近に親身になってくれる友人やご家族はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: It's completely natural to feel that you don't want to interact with them. You're in so much pain you can't even sleep. I think you've endured a lot, but I'm concerned about your well-being. Do you have any close friends or family who can offer support?

dialogue.content: 家族はいます。
dialogue.English: I have family.

dialogue.content: よかったです。ご家族とはどんなお話をしますか？
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. What kinds of conversations do you have with your family?

dialogue.content: 会社なんてそんなものだからといって、相談しても無駄です
dialogue.English: They say, "That's just how companies are," so it's pointless to talk to them about it.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…突き放された気持ちになっちゃいますね。あなたが抱く会社へのお気持ちは正直でいて良いと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I see... that can feel very dismissive. I think it's perfectly okay for you to be honest about how you feel about your workplace.

dialogue.content: 私の忍耐が足りないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Am I just not patient enough?

dialogue.content: 私の性格が弱いからだと言われます
dialogue.English: I'm told it's because I have a weak personality.

dialogue.content: 今日お話ししてあなたはとても忍耐強く、周りへ気配りをされる方と感じています
dialogue.English: From our conversation today, I see you as a very patient and considerate person.

dialogue.content: 弱かったら、あなたのように考えられないと思います。ご自身にもっと自信を持って良いと思いますよ
dialogue.English: If you were weak, I don't think you would be able to think the way you do. I believe you can have more confidence in yourself.

dialogue.content: 朝起きるのも辛いんです。仕方なく行ってます
dialogue.English: It's painful even to get up in the morning. I force myself to go.

dialogue.content: はい、今日のお話を伺って、きっと私でも同じ状況ならあなたと同じです
dialogue.English: Yes, after hearing your story today, I'm sure I would feel the same way if I were in your situation.

dialogue.content: 辞めたくても辞めれない。
dialogue.English: I want to quit, but I can't.

dialogue.content: そうお考えなんですね、今はあまり重要なことをご決断するより、少しご自分の時間をゆっくり取ってみてください
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you're feeling. Rather than making any major decisions right now, please try to take some time for yourself and slow down.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: なかなか難しいことかもしれませんが、距離をおいたり、ご自分自身の時間をゆっくり取ると、心も身体も少しリセットできるかもしれません
dialogue.English: It may be challenging, but creating some distance and taking time for yourself might help to reset your mind and body a bit.

dialogue.content: 距離をとったり、やれることはやったんですけどね。リセットした方がいいんですね？
dialogue.English: I've tried creating distance and doing what I can... So you think I should try to reset?

dialogue.content: 色々試みられてきたとは思います。リセットというかリフレッシュ的な何かが良いかと思いますよ。あなたにとって一番大切なことを、これからも大切にしていただけるよう応援しております
dialogue.English: I believe you've tried many things. Rather than a full reset, something more like a refresh might be helpful. I'm rooting for you to continue honoring what matters most to you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、たくさんお話を伺えてありがとうございました。お時間に近づきましたが、これまでお話ししていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for sharing so much with me. We're nearing the end of our time—how has it been for you to talk today?

dialogue.content: 話を聞いていただきありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。それでは今日はこちらで終了いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you, too. We will end our session here for today.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.
